source_text: ∆ιὰ τοῦτο ἐξ ἀνδρῶν ποιεῖται τῆς γενεαλογίας τὰ ὀνόματα, ἐπειδὴ "ἡ γυνὴ δόξα ἀνδρός ἐστι", παρακολούθημα οὖσα καὶ οὐκ ἀρχὴ τοῦ ἀνδρός.
pass_a_gloss: For this reason he makes the names of the genealogy from men, since "the woman is glory of man," being an accompaniment and not a beginning of the man.
pass_b_english: That is why the genealogy’s names run through men: “the woman is the glory of the man,” an accompaniment, not the man’s beginning.

choices.why: She follows man; not an independent origin of the line.
